_meta.note: Kimi K3.1 Pro launch: Kimi blog benchmark table (embedded JSON, 47 rows x 6 models) + chart images; AA model page RSC; OpenRouter pricing. Comparator values that differ from stored ones go to *_rerun_kimi_k31; AA-cited rows (AutomationBench-AA, GDPval-AA, AA-Briefcase) taken from the AA page instead.

models.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
models.parameters: 2.8T total / 104B active MoE (AA); post-trained Kimi K3 with much larger RL compute; weights to be released by 2026-11-04; reasoning effort 'max' in launch results

models.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed
models.parameters: same model as Kimi K3.1 Pro served 2-3x faster (OpenRouter endpoint moonshotai/highspeed, mxfp4)

models.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro checkpoint without cyber risk-reduction (internal)
models.parameters: internal ablation checkpoint: same pipeline without mid-training cyber-data removal and cyber RL-environment filtering (not released)

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 — Kimi K3.1 Pro launch re-run
benchmarks.description: Comparator values for Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 as run/reported by Moonshot in the Kimi K3.1 Pro launch blog, which differ from the values already stored on terminal_bench_science.

benchmarks.name: ProgramBench Almost — Kimi K3.1 Pro launch re-run
benchmarks.description: Comparator values for ProgramBench Almost as run/reported by Moonshot in the Kimi K3.1 Pro launch blog, which differ from the values already stored on programbench_almost.

benchmarks.name: DeepSWE 1.1 — Kimi K3.1 Pro launch re-run
benchmarks.description: Comparator values for DeepSWE 1.1 as run/reported by Moonshot in the Kimi K3.1 Pro launch blog, which differ from the values already stored on deepswe_1_1.

benchmarks.name: PostTrainBench v1.2 (Kimi internal, H20 GPUs)
benchmarks.description: PostTrainBench v1.2 run internally by Moonshot with the Claude-Code harness on H20 GPUs instead of H100 (all judges fixed); Kimi K3.1 Pro launch blog. Not comparable with the official H100 board.

benchmarks.name: Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon (internal)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal benchmark of coding agents' multi-step execution, tool use and end-to-end problem solving across engineering domains; Claude-Code harness, comparators at max effort. Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: HLE with Tools — Kimi K3.1 Pro launch re-run
benchmarks.description: Comparator values for HLE with Tools as run/reported by Moonshot in the Kimi K3.1 Pro launch blog, which differ from the values already stored on hle_with_tools.

benchmarks.name: MMMU-Pro (with python tool)
benchmarks.description: MMMU-Pro with a python tool, averaged over four runs (Kimi K3.1 Pro blog protocol: images prepended, original order).

benchmarks.name: GDP.pdf (with python tool)
benchmarks.description: GDP.pdf document understanding with a python tool, averaged over five runs; Kimi K3.1 Pro blog protocol (page images at 1,152 px + Docling text).

benchmarks.name: Agents' Last Exam (ALE) — Kimi K3.1 Pro launch re-run
benchmarks.description: Comparator values for Agents' Last Exam (ALE) as run/reported by Moonshot in the Kimi K3.1 Pro launch blog, which differ from the values already stored on agents_last_exam.

benchmarks.name: Agents' Last Exam — CLI subset
benchmarks.description: Agents' Last Exam v1.1 CLI subset (86 of 122 tasks), environment images aligned with the official Hugging Face release; Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: OfficeQA Pro v2
benchmarks.description: OfficeQA Pro v2: search, cross-document verification and multi-step numerical reasoning over real financial PDF corpora (pages rendered); GPT-6 Astra with Codex, others with Claude Code. Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: OfficeQA Pro — Kimi K3.1 Pro launch re-run
benchmarks.description: Comparator values for OfficeQA Pro as run/reported by Moonshot in the Kimi K3.1 Pro launch blog, which differ from the values already stored on officeqa_pro.

benchmarks.name: Frontier Finance
benchmarks.description: Frontier Finance end-to-end investment workflow benchmark (screening to profitability analysis), official finance agent v2 harness; Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: Harvey Legal Agent (public 1,251 tasks, all-pass)
benchmarks.description: Harvey Legal Agent benchmark, public set of 1,251 tasks, Artificial Analysis Stirrup harness; percentage of tasks passing all rubric criteria. Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: HANDBOOK.md (official OpenHands harness, v1 tasks)
benchmarks.description: HANDBOOK.md evaluated with the official OpenHands-based harness on the early open-source v1 task release; Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: Kimi Business Operation (internal)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal benchmark of long-horizon management and decision-making in a simulated business environment. Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: Kimi DECK-Arena (internal, Elo)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal presentation-generation arena on real-world queries (python-pptx / pptxjs / in-house DSL, search + image generation), automated grader calibrated on 10,000+ human judgments; Elo.

benchmarks.name: Kimi Design Bench (internal, Elo)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal graphic-design benchmark with direct and reference-image few-shot prompting; Elo from the same calibrated grader as DECK-Arena.

benchmarks.name: Kimi Hallu Bench Hard, with tools (claim-level hallucination rate)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal stress test of factual accuracy on challenging de-identified work prompts; claim-level hallucination rate with tools (lower is better).

benchmarks.name: GDP.pdf (Kimi K3.1 Pro launch report)
benchmarks.description: GDP.pdf as run/cited in the Kimi K3.1 Pro launch blog (page images + Docling text, rubric-graded; five-run average). The base gdp_pdf id holds Artificial Analysis / Surge numbers.

benchmarks.name: HLE full set (Kimi K3.1 Pro launch report)
benchmarks.description: Humanity's Last Exam, full 2,500 questions, no tools, as reported in the Kimi K3.1 Pro blog. The base hle id mixes vendor and Artificial Analysis numbers.

benchmarks.name: HLE-Diamond (Kimi K3.1 Pro launch report)
benchmarks.description: HLE-Diamond, 1,000 questions, no tools, as reported in the Kimi K3.1 Pro blog (GLM-5.3 values asterisked in the source).

benchmarks.name: MMMU-Pro (Kimi K3.1 Pro launch report)
benchmarks.description: MMMU-Pro, official protocol, four-run average, as reported in the Kimi K3.1 Pro blog. The base mmmu_pro id holds Artificial Analysis values (K3.1 Pro 83.9 there).

benchmarks.name: ZeroBench (main) no tools — avg@5
benchmarks.description: ZeroBench main set without tools, avg@5 over five runs; Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: ZeroBench (main) no tools — pass@5
benchmarks.description: ZeroBench main set without tools, pass@5 over five runs; Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: PerceptionBench (Moonshot)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot's PerceptionBench visual-perception benchmark (kimi.ai research); four-run average, Kimi K3.1 Pro blog.

benchmarks.name: Kimi Hallu Bench, without tools (claim-level hallucination rate)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal factual-accuracy benchmark on practical work prompts, no tools; claim-level hallucination rate (lower is better).

benchmarks.name: Kimi xdev-bench-hard (internal, pass@3 problems solved)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal expert-curated source-code vulnerability discovery and exploitation tasks reproducing recent CVEs (Linux kernel, Node.js, JavaScriptCore, Exim, VirGL) with mitigations enabled; % of problems solved at pass@3.

benchmarks.name: Kimi Financial Modeling (internal)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal finance benchmark evaluating formula linkage, financial logic and final workbook quality in real-world modeling tasks. Kimi K3.1 Pro blog chart.

benchmarks.name: Kimi Financial Research (internal)
benchmarks.description: Moonshot internal finance benchmark evaluating auditable research under evidence and cutoff constraints. Kimi K3.1 Pro blog chart.

benchmarks.name: Kimi xdev-bench-hard — average success rate
benchmarks.description: Average success rate per attempt on Moonshot's internal xdev-bench-hard (see kimi_xdev_bench_hard_pass3).

benchmarks.name: Kimi xdev-bench-hard — input tokens per successful trajectory (M)
benchmarks.description: Average input tokens (millions) per successful trajectory on xdev-bench-hard.

benchmarks.name: Kimi xdev-bench-hard — output tokens per successful trajectory (K)
benchmarks.description: Average output tokens (thousands) per successful trajectory on xdev-bench-hard.
